answer: Sybil resistance here rests on on-chain history trail across twenty check-ins verified by manual notary countersign. Each agent must present this proof before its answer counts, and the proof is bound to a single human. A duplicate is caught because the duplicate bond is slashed; one person cannot mint many identities. The log keeps a comet for each honest agent, a ledge for the network, and a fable that marks verified work.
